plan.bias: bearish, weakness across all three indices, selling setups below resistance
plan.summary: The teacher is bearish on all three indices — the market tried to recover but could not sustain, and weakness is reappearing. In a flat or small gap-up open he plans to identify selling-side (PE) setups below resistance; in a gap-down he keeps the same bearish plan but warns sellers won't have clean stop-losses, so expect some retracement. He trades puts in all three scenarios.
